title: Add Text to speech to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Text to speech](https://thinglover21-ux.github.io/My-app-mod) to video_audio
- App Description: A static web application featuring an Arabic (RTL) interface that implements the Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely on the client side, without a backend server. 

Fixes #15184

gist.headline: A voice for video_audio
gist.blurb: video_audio has learned to speak. An Arabic-first, browser-only little app now turns text into audio with Pollinations BYOP login—no server hive required.
gist.summary: Added Text to Speech to the video_audio app, with an Arabic RTL static interface that completes the Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE flow entirely in the browser.
gist.impact: Arabic-speaking makers can sign in through BYOP and generate speech in video_audio without deploying or maintaining a backend server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Arabic RTL text-to-speech workspace: a retro terminal turns Arabic script into gentle audio waveform flowers. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, tends the sound garden beside a friendly CRT monitor, making the client-side, no-backend flow feel simple and welcoming.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of a retro computer in an Arabic RTL workspace, where elegant Arabic text flows from the screen into soft pastel sound-wave flowers and a small lime green (#ecf874) audio garden; the cute pixel art bee mascot has a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, and she wears tiny headphones while tending the waveform flowers beside a curious chunky CRT monitor robot. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: 'TTS'.
